title: VPN profiles
name: Name
new_hint: A profile without an owner, for a device or a guest. Give it servers in its card. A person's profile comes with their account (People → Add a person).
freeze_hint: A frozen profile keeps its devices and settings but stops working on every server.
frozen_hint: The profile is frozen: it does not work on any server.
delete_hint: Deleting removes the profile from every server; the account stays.
freeze_confirm: Freeze this profile? Its devices stop connecting.
delete_confirm: Delete this profile? It is removed from every server; this cannot be undone.
staff_forever: a staff member's VPN does not expire
term_hint: Works until the end of the chosen day (UTC). Clear the date for no end.
tariff_expiry_start: The term starts again from today
tariff_expiry_extend: The term is extended by the tariff's days
tariff_expiry_keep: The term stays as it is
renewal_asked: The person asked for a renewal
access_staff: A staff member's VPN reaches every server with every protocol.
access_saved: Access is saved; the nodes apply it.
rules_hint: A rule gives every server it covers with the protocols ticked, servers added later included.
servers_hint: Give or take a server by hand. A rule's server taken here stays taken when the rule changes.
